diags.message: writing the undeclared name 'implicitGlobal' in a JavaScript source is not supported yet
diags.hint: a write to an undeclared name has no native lowering: sloppy mode makes it a property on Node's global object, which a native binary has none of, and strict mode makes it throw; declare the name, or keep the module in a Node island (sloppy-mode programs route there)
